title: Sharplink footer
description: A footer where the page's paper gives way to a band of pale blue, saturated blue and black that rises as you scroll in: a three-column grid with a sign-up form on a dotted underline, navigation in two sub-columns of 19px links (underline grows on hover) and social links with a back-to-top box, a bottom row of narrow uppercase listing, legal and copyright lines, and a giant wordmark across the full width fading to the bottom edge.
notes: the content uses the theme's dark colours (.dark); the band starts from the light page's paper
the band's rise is a CSS view timeline; without support or with reduced motion it sits in its final place
the giant wordmark is the company name as type (the original draws it in WebGL)
name: sharplink-footer
